gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-123.160374 44.638732)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1100 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH hyak_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-123.160374, 44.638732), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
rast_clip AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_Union(rast)).geom AS geom,
    (ST_Union(rast)).rast AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, hyak_point.geom)
),
elevation_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_MapAlgebraExpr(
      rast_clip.rast,
      '([rast] > 1100)::INT',
      '32BF'
    ) AS rast
  FROM rast_clip
),
distance_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(
      hyak_point.geom,
      ST_AsGeography(
        ST_PixelAsCentroids(
          elevation_raster.rast,
          TRUE
        )
      )
    ) AS distance_meters
  FROM hyak_point, elevation_raster
  WHERE ST_Value(elevation_raster.rast, 1, 1) = 1
  ORDER BY distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT distance_meters FROM distance_analysis;
